# Customization

Design token overrides, component composition patterns, theming, and dark
mode support. See [citations.md](../citations.md) for source details.

## Theme System

PatternFly 6 ships three themes [6]:

| Theme | Activation | Contrast | Status |
|-------|-----------|----------|--------|
| Light | Default | Standard WCAG AA | GA |
| Dark | `pf-v6-theme-dark` class on `<html>` | Standard WCAG AA | GA |
| High Contrast | (not documented) | 7:1 ratios, wider borders | Beta (6.4.0) |

### Theme Switching Mechanism

1. Check localStorage for stored preference [6]
2. Fall back to system `prefers-color-scheme` media query [6]
3. Apply `pf-v6-theme-dark` class to document root when dark mode active [6]

## Token Customization Hierarchy

Developers must follow a strict hierarchy when customizing [6][8]:

1. **Semantic tokens** — preferred; convey design intent
2. **Base tokens** — fallback when no semantic token fits
3. **Never use palette tokens directly** — they are internal-only [6][8]

Key rule: "Always use tokens to create custom styles... never use hard-coded
values like hex codes or color names" [6].

### Token Override Pattern

Override component variables using CSS custom properties rather than inline
color values [7]:

```css
.pf-v6-c-button {
  --pf-v6-c-button--m-primary--BackgroundColor: var(--pf-t--global--color--brand--default);
}
```

Avoid reverse-engineering from hex values during migration — focus on semantic
function [8].

## Dark Theme Implementation

### Automatic

Components built on design tokens automatically adapt between light and dark
themes [6][7]. Token values change when the `pf-v6-theme-dark` class is applied.

### Manual Requirements

**Charts** require a separate CSS import [7]:
```
@patternfly/patternfly/patternfly-charts.css
```

**Images** require one of four approaches [7]:
1. Inline SVG with token-based fills — adapts automatically
2. Universal colors — WCAG AA contrast in both themes
3. Container approach — background/border framing for dynamic images
4. CSS swapping — `display` properties toggled by dark theme class

## Animation Customization

Three motion patterns available [9]:
- Button Ripple — click feedback
- Error Jiggle — validation feedback (fades in under reduced motion)
- Expansion Fade and Slide — expanding content (fade-only under reduced motion)

6.4.0 added application-level context providers for simplified animation
control across an entire application [4].

## Component Composition

PatternFly uses Atomic Design + modified BEM (Block, Element, Modifier)
methodology. Components are isolated, modular structures that compose into
complex patterns [16].

Three structure categories:
- **Components** — modular presentation structures
- **Layouts** — organizational containers (`.pf-v6-l-*` prefix)
- **Demos** — composition examples with no additional styling

## Design Resources

Figma design kit includes complete component library and design token system [16].
Sketch is deprecated — PatternFly 6 is Figma-only. Figma tokens use forward
slash (/) instead of double hyphen (--) but align with CSS token structure [1].

## Gaps and Limitations

- No walkthrough for creating a fully custom brand theme beyond dark/light
- High contrast mode is beta — completeness and known issues undocumented
- Charts and images require manual work for dark theme [7]
- Total token count not published — unclear how many overridable tokens exist
